title: Nontrivial bounds on extractable energy in quantum energy teleportation for gapped manybody systems with a unique ground state
summary: We establish an exponentially decaying upper bound on the average energy that can be extracted in quantum energy teleportation (QET) protocols executed on finite-range {gapped} lattice systems possessing a unique ground state.
